runs.question: How long after OMB M-25-22 is issued does it start to apply to new AI contracts?

answer.text:
M-25-22 reaches new AI contracts 180 days after it was issued. The count runs from the memo's issuance date, and a contract falls under it only if the solicitation is released on or after that day. The memorandum applies to any contract awarded pursuant to a solicitation issued on or after the date that is 180 days after issuance of this memorandum, as well as to any option to renew or extend the period of performance exercised on an existing contract after that date.

The passages do not give the memo's exact issuance date, so I can't convert the 180 days into a calendar date. Also, AI acquired for use as a component of a National Security System falls outside the memo entirely.

support.reason: Passage states the same applicability to solicitations issued on or after 180 days and to exercised options after that date.
Passage states the memorandum does not apply to AI acquired as a component of a National Security System.
